avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce mometasone systemic bioavailability and efficacy when absorbed systemically
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced corticosteroid response

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Licorice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid effects compound corticosteroid-induced hypokalemia and sodium retention
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose licorice supplements during mometasone therapy

caution_supplements.name: Calcium/Vitamin D
caution_supplements.mechanism: Chronic corticosteroid use increases bone loss risk; supplementation supportive but not an interaction
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation to mitigate osteoporosis risk with long-term mometasone use

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Systemic corticosteroid absorption may increase sodium retention and hypertension risk
caution_foods.action: Monitor sodium intake during prolonged systemic mometasone exposure, especially inhaled high-dose formulations

monitoring_notes: Mometasone has low systemic bioavailability due to local administration (inhaled/intranasal/topical) and rapid hepatic metabolism, minimizing drug interactions. Monitor for HPA axis suppression and adrenal insufficiency with prolonged use, particularly in pediatric patients.
